system.description: Begin each conflict with (SL) Tempo; +1 when an enemy misses you in Parry Stance, +1 when you deal damage in Lunge Stance. Enter at the start of your turn by spending 7 Tempo: Attribute dice one size higher (max d12) and all damage doubled before Affinities, until end of turn.
